[In a sealed-bid second-price auction, bidding my true value is weakly dominant and maximizes expected payoff. There is no history to learn from this single round. Bidding exactly my private value ($26) ensures I win when others bid below 26 and, if I win, I pay the second-highest bid—avoiding paying more than the item is worth to me. Submit 26.0.]
